{{Quote|Shortly after seceding, both the Queen and the heir to the Alderaanian throne were assassinated. A usurper, Bouris Ulgo, stepped into power, setting off a civil war.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Syo Bakarn]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Silara Panteer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and a member of the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[House Panteer]] who served as the [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. However, her son [[Gaul Panteer]] withdrew the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the Republic in his capacity as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in protest of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that ended the Great Galactic War in [[3653 BBY]], and Silara was [[Death/Legends|killed]] a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash, shortly after her son was murdered by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. The [[King/Legends|Queen's]] death led to the [[Alderaan Civil War]], as [[House Ulgo|Houses Ulgo]], [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]], [[House of Thul|Thul]], and Panteer fought to claim Alderaan's throne.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I failed my queen, and now Alderaan is leaderless. Queen Panteer was killed when her transport crashed in this river. Her body was found, but her crown still lies in the water.|Sir Deris of the Queensguard|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="Holonet" /> Silara Panteer<ref name="Armed">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Armed Intervention|Alderaan}}</ref> was a member of [[House Panteer]], a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family and one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great Houses]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="House Panteer" /> Panteer became [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] sometime before [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Journal" /> continuing decades of Panteer rule before her,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and she also bore a son named [[Gaul Panteer|Gaul]].<ref name="Holonet" /> During her reign, Queen Panteer was beloved by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] populace, and even her adversaries greatly respected the monarch and her undisputed rule.<ref name="House Panteer" /> In 3667 BBY, during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Alderaan was [[Battle of Alderaan|invaded]] by the Empire, and during the invasion Imperial forces under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] razed [[Castle Panteer]] and captured the royal family. However, the Queen and her family were later rescued by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces who succeeded in repelling the Imperials.<ref name="Journal" />

By [[3653 BBY]], the Queen's son Gaul had become Alderaan's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Alderaan hosted [[Alderaan peace conference|peace talks]] between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, but when the Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|attacked]] the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic was forced to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that ended the war. An enraged Gaul Panteer declared Alderaan's independence and stormed out of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in disgust, returning to his homeworld. Queen Panteer also became ill around this [[Time/Legends|time]], and her health steadily worsened over the next few years as Gaul entered into secret negotiations to return Alderaan to the Republic. However, Gaul was [[Death/Legends|murdered]]<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=codex|The War For Alderaan's Throne}}</ref> by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] of [[House Rist]] on the orders of [[House Ulgo]],<ref name="Red">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Red Handed|Alderaan}}</ref> and Queen Silara's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashed only [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later<ref name="War" /> in the [[Glarus Valley]] after being sabotaged, leading to her death.<ref name="Head" />

The Queen's body was recovered from the river, but she had not been wearing the [[Panteer crown|royal crown]], which sank to the bottom of the river in its [[Duralloy/Legends|duralloy]] container.<ref name="Head" /> In the weeks that followed, tensions soon broke out into open war as [[Bouris Ulgo]] declared himself king, and a four-way war between the Republic-backed [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], the Empire-backed [[House of Thul|House Thul]], House Ulgo, and House Panteer erupted as the [[Alderaan Civil War]] began.<ref name="War" />
